people.name: Amnon
people.line: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Nephew of David, friend and advisor to Amnon

people.name: Shimeah
people.line: Brother of David; father of Jonadab (or 'Jonathan').

translations.web: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.
translations.bsb: Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah. Jonadab was a very shrewd man,
